answer: Reef membership with history-overlap detection keeps sybil aliases out of the agent economy. A reef admits an alias only after 21 epochs of honest work, and members earn jobs at rates 40 percent above the open market. Every member carries a lantern beacon publishing a signed daily task summary, so peers can compare histories. When two beacons show more than 80 percent overlap in clients and timestamps across 14 epochs, the reef flags them as one operator, ejects both aliases, and burns their reputation. Faking 100 aliases then costs 2,100 epochs of waiting for zero payout.
